business.label: Business details
business.hint: The café as a whole. Each shop's address, phone and opening hours are under Locations.

name.label: Café name
name.hint: Shown in the header, the footer, the browser tab and search results.

phone.label: Phone
phone.hint: The main number, shown in the footer and on the contact page.

priceRange.label: Price range
priceRange.hint: As search engines show it, e.g. $ or $$.

pageText.label: Page text
pageText.hint: The words on the home page and the About page. Keep {name} where you see it: it becomes the café's name from Business details. Section labels, buttons and form labels stay in the file.

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.hint: Under the name in search results and when the site is shared.

imageAlt.label: Picture description
imageAlt.hint: Read out by screen readers; shown if the picture fails to load.

summary.label: One-paragraph summary
summary.hint: Shown on the About page; search engines and AI assistants also read it as the café's description.

name.label: Item name
name.hint: As it reads on the board, e.g. Flat White.

description.label: Short description
description.hint: One line under the name. Optional.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.hint: Adds a Seasonal badge next to the item.

available.label: Show on the menu
available.hint: Switch off to hide the item for now. To remove it for good, delete the item.

featured.label: Show on the home page
featured.hint: Also show this item on the home page.

locations.label: Locations
locations.bodyHint: For your own reference. The site does not show this text.

name.label: Shop name
name.hint: As it reads on the site, e.g. NW Thimbleberry Avenue.

addressCountry.label: Country code
addressCountry.hint: Two letters, e.g. US, GB, DE.

phone.label: Shop phone
phone.hint: Optional. Kept with this shop's details; the site shows the main phone number your developer set, not this one.

mapUrl.label: Directions link
mapUrl.hint: Where the Get directions button goes. Paste the share link from your map app: the full address, starting with https://

hours.label: Opening hours
hours.hint: One entry per day. For a day the shop is closed, tick "Closed all day": the times are then ignored. A day that closes after midnight has a closing time earlier than its opening time.

wifi.label: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.hint: Shows a Free Wi-Fi line on the shop card.

outlets.label: Power outlets
outlets.hint: Shows a Power outlets line on the shop card.

laptopFriendly.label: Laptop-friendly
laptopFriendly.hint: Shows a Laptop-friendly line on the shop card.

primary.label: Main shop
primary.hint: The home page card and the details search engines read come from the main shop. Switch it on for one shop only.

legal.label: Privacy and terms
legal.bodyHint: Have your own lawyer read this before you publish. The shipped text is a starting structure, not legal advice.

description.label: Short description
description.hint: One sentence about what this page covers. Search results show it under the page title.

updated.label: Last updated
updated.hint: The day you last changed this text.
